name: Bound keys only: the setting, its audited switch, and a preview that says what it did not decide
summary: The setting bound_keys_only (deployment.private.json; absent or false is off) makes the forced command of an authorized_keys line refuse a line that names no project and no principal; the switch (admin.py bound-keys-only status/on/off, operator-gated, audited, off by default) previews what on would cut off, in three groups. REFUSED: a line of this kit's own wrapper file and this root, a command needing no shell on no relative path - would_be_refused (twenty numbers, would_be_refused_more, truncated with its warning) in status, on and the listing. MAY BE REFUSED: every other wrapper or root, a command needing the shell, a relative or $HOME path - not decided, printed by status and on as may_be_refused with may_be_refused_more, with whether the wrapper file names the setting said as a HINT from its first 64 KiB (once per file; a fifo never opened); a word in a file is a hint, not a decision. on REFUSES to flip when the keys file cannot be read or was only partly inspected (an empty or non-regular --file refused) unless the operator says so with --without-preview. Line numbers follow the line feed alone; the audit status prints is bounded.
